create_runner_subclass: create a subclass of Runner that implements run, save_state, and load_state methods
test_mockrunner: test MockRunner by creating an instance with x, y, z values and calling run to get their sum
save_mockrunner_state: save MockRunner state to a checkpoint directory as mock_state.json using save_state method
load_mockrunner_state: load MockRunner state from a checkpoint directory using load_state to restore x, y, z values
implement_preemptablemixin: implement PreemptableMixin in a Runner subclass to add STOPFAIR preemption and atomic checkpointing support
